subject: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Team — attaching the monthly snapshot and a short cost anomaly drill. I want to use the leadership QBR next week to be explicit about a few operational opportunities we can commit to before end of Q2. High-level ask: review the dashboard and call out 1) any correctness/collection gaps, 2) predictable wins (cache rules, routing changes, batching knobs), and 3) owners for a quick pilot.

Quick notes from my pass: 
- Latency: p50 stable; p95 spiked on 2027-01-21 (EU) and again small blips 01/29 (hosted).
- Cost: token cost per request up 9% MoM; top contributor appears to be a subset of long-context chat sessions.
- Uptime: one 18-min degradation (EU) tied to a driver upgrade; incident attached.
- Usage: steady growth in embeddings batch traffic from analytics customers (good signal).

Attachments: 202702-dashboard-summary.pdf, 202702-cost-anomaly-drill.xlsx

Proposed next steps: 
1) Pre-QBR 30-min sync with ops + product (suggest Fri 2/4 10:30 PT) — confirm availability.
2) Each of you to reply with 1 prioritized action and owner by EOD Thu.
3) I'll consolidate into the QBR slide and a short mitigation runbook for the EU blip.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Vivek — thanks for the concise summary and attachments. Quick reactions: 
- I can take point on the long-context traffic: we should sample the top 50 request traces and validate model selection + tokenization to see if truncation or prompt templating reduces cost.
- I'll ask analytics to add usage segmentation by client tier (prod vs experimental). That will help determine if usage is concentrated in a few customers.

Availability: Fri 2/4 10:30 PT works for me.

-Lauren
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Looping in a quick metric detail. From infra metrics: 
- EU p95 spike (2027-01-21 03:14 UTC): concurrent kernel scheduling backlog observed for ~17m, correlated with a driver push that ran during a maintenance window. I've exported the incident log attached (incident-log-eu-20270121.txt).
- Cost breakdown: ~62% of the increase came from high-context chat sessions (>=2048 tokens). Another 18% from daily embedding batch spikes (between 03:00-05:00 UTC).

Proposal: trial a two-week conservative context cap for non-enterprise tiers + soft truncation with a prompt rewrite experiment. Owner: Marcus to run sampling and cost projection; Lauren to own rollout gating.

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Thanks — good framing. Two small asks from the exec prep side: 
1) Can we get a one-slide before/after example for the proposed context cap experiment (what we expect to save and any customer impact)?
2) Please draft a single-line customer-facing explanation for support and sales to surface if customers ask about truncation.

I'm available for the Fri 10:30 PT sync. I'll bring a condensed QBR slide template — please attach any concise before/after numbers to the shared Drive link so I can pull them in.

-Laura
Head of GTM Operations
From: Alice Monroe <alice@nimbus.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Hi Vivek & team — thanks for the transparency. Nimbus is seeing similar long-context patterns in our embedding + chat flows; happy to share a 7-day anonymized usage CSV if that helps triangulate. We're available for the Fri slot; prefer 11:00 PT if possible.

Attaching note: we'll redact PII before sending.

—Alice
Head of Data, Nimbus Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice@nimbus.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service performance opportunity scan & QBR prep (Feb)

Thanks everyone — summary and owners below. I've updated the Drive folder and attached a short agenda (qbr-prep-agenda.docx). Please treat the items below as commitments for the pre-QBR sync (Fri 2/4 10:30 PT — adjusted to 11:00 PT to accommodate Nimbus).

Action items (owner — due):
- Sample top 50 long-context traces & cost projection (Marcus — EOD Thu 2/4).
- One-slide expected impact for exec deck + customer line (Lauren — Fri 2/4 9:30 PT).
- Add usage segmentation (prod vs experimental) to dashboard (Tessa — EOD Thu 2/4).
- Confirm incident remediation steps and add to runbook (Marcus — EOD Thu 2/4).
- Collect Nimbus anonymized 7-day CSV and add to Drive (Alice — Thu 2/4).

Meeting: Fri 2027-02-04 11:00 PT (30m) — join link in Drive doc.

If anything blocks owners meeting the due times, flag in this thread. I'll fold the results into the QBR slides and a short ops play we can push to the console.

Vivek
VP, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
